preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 1000 inclusive.
Exactly n-1 edges are provided in the input.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].
The provided edges form a valid tree structure (connected and acyclic).
The hidden root vertex r is a valid vertex index between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The final output line is of the form '! r' where r is the correct root vertex.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for line in output_lines if line.startswith('? ')) <= n // 2
postconditions.description: The total number of queries made (lines starting with '?') does not exceed floor(n/2).

postconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('? ') and len(line.split()) == 3 and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n and 1 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= n for line in output_lines if line.startswith('? '))
postconditions.description: Every query line contains exactly two valid vertex indices u and v within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: not any(line.strip() == '-1' for line in input_lines)
postconditions.description: The interaction did not terminate due to an invalid query or exceeding the query limit (indicated by receiving -1).
